settings.heading: Where are Viking Sauna Co. products manufactured?
settings.row_content: Viking Sauna Co. is proudly headquartered in Boise, Idaho, USA. All saunas are hand-crafted in the USA using premium natural cedar and designed for long-term outdoor performance.

settings.heading: What products do you currently offer?
settings.row_content:
Our current lineup includes:

  • Leif 2-Person Outdoor Sauna Pod
  • Erik 4-Person Outdoor Sauna Pod
  • Ragnar 4-Person Outdoor Barrel Sauna
  • Roof kits for all 3 sauna models
  • Under-bench LED lighting kit

Additional models and accessories may be introduced in the future.

settings.heading: Are heaters included with the saunas?
settings.row_content: HUUM and Harvia electric sauna heaters can be added to any sauna purchase, but heaters are not included by default.

settings.heading: Are Viking saunas rated for outdoor use year-round?
settings.row_content: Yes. Viking Sauna Co. saunas are designed specifically for outdoor placement and long-term exposure when properly installed and maintained.

settings.heading: How are Viking Sauna kits shipped?
settings.row_content: All saunas ship as palletized kits via LTL freight. This allows for efficient nationwide delivery while protecting the product during transit.

settings.heading: What is the typical lead time?
settings.row_content: Lead times may vary depending on inventory and production schedules. Typically, we can ship out any sauna within 1 week of purchase, usually faster!

settings.heading: Is assembly required?
settings.row_content: Yes. All Viking Sauna Co. models require on-site assembly. Detailed assembly instructions are provided with each kit.

settings.heading: Do the saunas include a floor?
settings.row_content: Yes, all Viking Sauna Co. sauna models include a premium natural cedar floor system as standard.

settings.heading: Do you offer optional upgrades?
settings.row_content:
Yes. Current optional upgrades include:

  • Cedar shingle roof package with underlayment
  • Under-bench LED lighting kit with local remote

Upgrade availability may vary by model.

settings.heading: Are Viking saunas protected by a warranty?
settings.row_content: All Viking Sauna Co. saunas are backed by a 5-year warranty on materials and craftsmanship. Full warranty details are available on each product page.

settings.heading: How are warranty claims handled?
settings.row_content:
Warranty claims should be submitted through the Contact page on vikingsaunaco.com and must include:

  • Your name
  • Date of purchase
  • Description of the issue
  • Photos (if applicable)
